entities.summary: Li Kotomi, is the pen name of a Taiwanese fiction writer, translator, and essayist in Mandarin and Japanese. Her native language is Mandarin Chinese, but her novels are predominantly written in Japanese. Her literary career began in 2017 with the Japanese novel titled Hitorimai, which received the 60th Gunzo Prize for New Writers that year. Her novel Higanbana ga saku shima received the 165th Akutagawa Prize, which was established in 1935 in commemoration of Ryūnosuke Akutagawa.
